paite: Aw sepaihhonte' tanu, tu in sepaih hon kaikhawm inla; amau ahon umsuakta ua; Israelte vaihawmpa abiang ah sikchiang in asun ding uhi.
heading: Zion Vualzohna Genkholhna
english: Now you shall gather yourself in troops, daughter of troops. He has laid siege against us. They will strike the judge of Israel with a rod on the cheek.

paite: Himahleh nang, Bethlehem Ephratha aw, Judah gam a sang tampi lak a tel ding in neu tawk lechin leng, nang a kipan in Israelte vaihawmpa ding kei a ding in ahong pawt ding; ahong pawtna sawtpi, tang lai nite a kipan ahi.
heading: Bethlehem A Pan Vaihawmtu Hong Pawt Ding
english: But you, Bethlehem Ephrathah, being small among the clans of Judah, out of you one will come forth to me that is to be ruler in Israel; whose goings forth are from of old, from everlasting.

paite: Huaiziak in nauveimi'n asuahsak mateng amau alehngatsan ding; huchi in a-unau khosuaksunte Israel suante kiang ah akik nawn ding uhi.
english: Therefore he will abandon them until the time that she who is in labor gives birth. Then the rest of his brothers will return to the children of Israel.

paite: Amah adingh dia, TOUPA a Pathian min thupina ngei in; amaute a-omta ding ua; amah lah lei tawp pha in athupi ding hi.
english: He shall stand, and shall shepherd in the strength of Yahweh, in the majesty of the name of Yahweh his God: and they will live, for then he will be great to the ends of the earth.

paite: Huan hiai mi kilemna ahi ding; Assuria mi agam ua ahong a, i kumpipa uh innte ahon sik chiang in, amah dou ding in belampu sagih leh mithupi giat i kitelkhe ding uhi.
english: He will be our peace when Assyria invades our land, and when he marches through our fortresses, then we will raise against him seven shepherds, and eight leaders of men.

paite: Assuria gam namsau in ahihse ding ua, Nimrod gam a lutna ahihse lai ding uh; huan ama'n, i gam ua Assuria mi hong pai a, i gam chiang uh ahong sik hun chiang in, amah a kipan in ahon hunkhe ding hi.
english: They will rule the land of Assyria with the sword, and the land of Nimrod in its gates. He will deliver us from the Assyrian, when he invades our land, and when he marches within our border.

paite: Jakob mi khosuaksunte chi tampi lak ah TOUPA a kipan a daitui kia bang leh loupa tung a vuahzu bang in a-om ding uh; huai in mihing angak kei a, mihing tapate angak sam kei hi.
heading: Israel Khosuaksunte Sep Ding
english: The remnant of Jacob will be in the midst of many peoples, like dew from Yahweh, like showers on the grass, that don’t wait for man, nor wait for the sons of men.

paite: Jakob khosuaksunte namte lak ah leh chi tampite lak ah gamnuai sate lak a humpinelkai bang leh belamhon lak a humpinelkai lun lai bang in a-om ding; ama'n apaisuak peuhmahte asikden a, abotnen a, humbit ding leng kuamah a-om kei uh.
english: The remnant of Jacob will be among the nations, in the midst of many peoples, like a lion among the animals of the forest, like a young lion among the flocks of sheep; who, if he goes through, treads down and tears in pieces, and there is no one to deliver.

paite: Na khut nang hon doute tung ah lik in om henla, na melma tengteng hihman in om hen.
english: Let your hand be lifted up above your adversaries, and let all of your enemies be cut off.

paite: Huai ni chiang in hichi ahi ding a, TOUPA'N achi, nang a kipan in na sakolte ka hihmang ding a, na kangtalaite ka hihse ding;
heading: TOUPA'N Israel Asuksianna
english: “It will happen in that day,” says Yahweh, “That I will cut off your horses out of the midst of you, and will destroy your chariots.

paite: na khopite ka hihmang ding a, na kulhhat tengteng ka hihchim ding;
english: I will cut off the cities of your land, and will tear down all your strongholds.

paite: na khut a kipan bumsiamte ka hihmang ding a; aisan siamte ka hihmang ding; aisan siamte na nei nawnta kei ding hi;
english: I will destroy witchcraft from your hand; and you shall have no soothsayers.

paite: nang a kipan na milim bawltawmte leh na suangphuhte ka hihmang ding a; na khutsuakte na be nawn kei ding hi.
english: I will cut off your engraved images and your pillars out of your midst; and you shall no more worship the work of your hands.

paite: Nang a kipan Asherahte ka botkhe ding a; na khopite ka hihse ding hi.
english: I will uproot your Asherim out of your midst; and I will destroy your cities.

paite: Huan thu ngaikhe lou namte tung ah hehna leh thangpaihna in phulakna ka pichingsak ding hi.
english: I will execute vengeance in anger, and wrath on the nations that didn’t listen.”
